# Wisp torch

# Introduction

The Wisp torch is a special light source.

## Usage

The wisp torch allows the player to permanently clear part of the mist within Mistlands in a 12m radius. It does not have to be built close to a Workbench or another crafting station.
Unlike other placeable torches, it requires no fuel. It also does not create a player base, thus creatures can still spawn around it.

Categorias: Furniture, Light sources
